about: The set-up's steps, in order, with the name and question each one shows. The browser set-up (settings.js, install.js) and the terminal set-up (starboard/terminal_setup.py) both read this file, so a step has the same name in both. Each set-up shows only the steps that apply to it. Each step's help is its help centre article (docs/help path), opened from Help with this step.
